description: Project-scoped AI-OS Codex lifecycle hooks. SessionStart projects shared Execution Plane state (CAMPAIGN_STATE/TASK_ENTRY); does not takeover or bump generation.

hooks.command: python -X utf8 -c "from pathlib import Path; import runpy; p=next((d/'scripts'/'ai_os_codex_hook.py') for d in (Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents) if (d/'scripts'/'ai_os_codex_hook.py').is_file()); runpy.run_path(str(p), run_name='__main__')"
